canada.title: Canada
canada.heroDesc: Your Gateway to Study, Work, and Settle.
canada.whyDesc1: Canada is consistently ranked as one of the best countries in the world for quality of life. It offers a safe, multicultural, and welcoming environment for immigrants from all over the globe.
canada.whyDesc2: With a world-class education system, a strong, growing economy, and clear pathways to permanent residency, Canada presents an unparalleled opportunity for your future.

whyCards.title: Top Universities
whyCards.desc: Home to globally-recognized institutions and post-graduate work permits.

whyCards.title: Strong Economy
whyCards.desc: High demand for skilled workers in tech, healthcare, and trades.

whyCards.title: Welcoming Culture
whyCards.desc: A diverse, multicultural society that welcomes immigrants.

pathways.title: Study Visa (SDS)
pathways.desc: The Student Direct Stream (SDS) offers a streamlined process for students from select countries to get a study permit faster for designated learning institutions.

pathways.title: Work Permits
pathways.desc: From LMIA-based closed work permits to Spousal Open Work Permits (SOWP), we navigate the complexities of working legally in Canada.

pathways.title: Express Entry (PR)
pathways.desc: The gold standard for skilled workers. We help maximize your CRS score for Federal Skilled Worker (FSW) and Canadian Experience Class (CEC).

pathways.title: Visitor Visa
pathways.desc: Whether for tourism or visiting family, we ensure your application demonstrates strong ties to your home country for a successful approval.

uk.title: United Kingdom
uk.heroDesc: Home of History, Culture, and World-Class Education.
uk.whyDesc1: The United Kingdom offers a unique blend of rich history and modern innovation. Its universities are legendary, and its cities are global hubs for finance, tech, and the creative arts.
uk.whyDesc2: With the new Graduate Route visa, international students can now stay and work (or look for work) for up to two years after completing their degree, making it one of the most attractive destinations today.

whyCards.title: World-Class Education
whyCards.desc: Study at prestigious universities like Oxford, Cambridge, and LSE.

whyCards.title: Graduate Route (PSW)
whyCards.desc: Stay and work in the UK for 2 years post-graduation (3 years for PhD).

whyCards.title: Historic Culture
whyCards.desc: Live and work in a country with a rich, globally-influential history.

pathways.title: Student Visa
pathways.desc: Obtain a Student Visa to pursue degrees at UK Higher Education institutions. Covers pre-sessional courses and pathway options.

pathways.title: Graduate Visa (PSW)
pathways.desc: Stay in the UK and work, or look for work, for 2 years after graduating from a recognized UK degree program.

pathways.title: Skilled Worker Visa
pathways.desc: Allows you to come to or stay in the UK to do an eligible job with an approved sponsor.

pathways.title: Visitor Visa
pathways.desc: For tourism, business meetings, or visiting family, with high success rates from our experienced guidance.

australia.title: Australia
australia.heroDesc: Explore Academic Excellence and High Quality of Life Down Under.
australia.whyDesc1: Australia boasts some of the world's most liveable cities, a robust economy, and world-class universities. It offers students and skilled workers a balanced lifestyle and rich opportunities.
australia.whyDesc2: The post-study work visa program in Australia provides a direct route for graduates to build international careers in fields ranging from engineering to skilled trades.

whyCards.title: Great Lifestyle
whyCards.desc: Beautiful climate, friendly communities, and a high standard of living.

whyCards.title: High Wages
whyCards.desc: Strong minimum wage laws and exceptional earning potential for professionals.

whyCards.title: Top Universities
whyCards.desc: Study at top-tier Group of Eight institutions with global rankings.

pathways.title: Student Visa (Subclass 500)
pathways.desc: Enables international students to study full-time in registered courses, with pathway options to post-study work.

pathways.title: Temporary Graduate (Subclass 485)
pathways.desc: Allows international graduates to live, study, and work in Australia temporarily after completing their studies.

pathways.title: Skilled Migration (PR)
pathways.desc: Pathways like Subclass 189 and 190 based on a points system for skilled professionals and trades.

pathways.title: Visitor Visa (Subclass 600)
pathways.desc: Streamlined processing for tourist, business visitor, and family visits with highly customized SOPs.

us.title: USA
us.heroDesc: The Land of Opportunity Awaits You.
us.whyDesc1: The United States is home to many of the world's top-ranked universities and leading technology companies. It offers unparalleled opportunities for academic growth, research, and career advancement.
us.whyDesc2: Whether you're looking to pursue a degree at an Ivy League school or gain international work experience through OPT, the US remains the most sought-after destination for ambitious students and professionals.

whyCards.title: Academic Excellence
whyCards.desc: Access to cutting-edge research facilities and world-renowned faculty.

whyCards.title: Innovation Hub
whyCards.desc: Be at the center of technological advancements and entrepreneurial spirit.

whyCards.title: Cultural Diversity
whyCards.desc: Experience a melting pot of cultures and broaden your global perspective.

pathways.title: Student Visa (F-1)
pathways.desc: For academic studies at an accredited US college, university, or language program. Includes potential for Optional Practical Training (OPT).

pathways.title: Exchange Visitor (J-1)
pathways.desc: For individuals participating in work-and-study-based exchange visitor programs approved by the US Department of State.

pathways.title: Work Visas (H-1B)
pathways.desc: For specialty occupations requiring theoretical or technical expertise, sponsored by US employers.

pathways.title: Visitor Visa (B-1/B-2)
pathways.desc: For business, pleasure, or medical treatment, ensuring a thorough case profile for approval.
